decisions.rationale: The English ordinal suffix th duplicates the Arabic rank phrase and is linguistic, not exponentiation. Preserve the mathematical index (n+m) and MSA genitive ذي after تعيين; remove only the explicitly language-owned superscript wrapper.

We often just write $g(n, m)$ rather that $g(\tuple{n, m})$, since it
is easier on the eyes. This tells you first to determine the
$(n+m)^\text{th}$ triangle number, and then add $n$ to it. And
it populates the array in exactly the way we would like. So in
particular, the pair $\tuple{1, 2}$ is sent to $\frac{4 \times 3}{2} +
1 = 7$.

decisions.rationale: Masculine اتحاد/هو cannot directly take the shared feminine adjective قابلة للتعداد. Keep the family, components and union statement unchanged; no foundational countable-choice claim is added. The second union predicate has the same masculine-subject/feminine-adjective mismatch.
